scope: pure stdlib in-memory canonical accounting, fitting-only fold preparation and their join; fabricated fixtures only

feature_split.normalizer: fit-only population mean/std; std floor 1e-12; deterministic sorted UIDs and math.fsum; never clip
feature_split.transform_domain: finite only; legacy VJP abs<=2 reported diagnostically, not imposed by silent clipping
feature_split.barrier: validate every feature and split before inspecting action/outcome containers or attempt rows
feature_split.outcomes: exact fitting UIDs only, SUCCESS and D95=1; terminal failures rejected, never dropped
feature_split.positives: all exact-integer 100*cycles <= 101*minimum_cycles within each fitting circuit
feature_split.task_denominator: retain all five families including all-positive groups; B=N*max(charged cost)

canonical_accounting.cost: math.fsum of every supplied attempt elapsed including FAILED/TIMEOUT/retries; never fastest-success
canonical_accounting.missing_elapsed: reject; no timeout, CPU-time, cycles or pattern-count substitution
canonical_accounting.zero_elapsed: individual zero allowed; total action charge must be positive
canonical_accounting.uniqueness: global attempt ID, action UID, and action/stage/retry_order; contiguous stage retry orders starting zero
canonical_accounting.terminal_success: explicit action measurement SUCCESS plus all scheme stages terminal SUCCESS; no attempt after a stage SUCCESS
canonical_accounting.environment: attempt cohort equals action cohort; one cohort per circuit in joined fold and replay
canonical_assumptions_NOT_verified: each action row is one canonical invocation, not multiple independent reruns pooled together
elapsed items are serial, exclusive and nonoverlapping, not inclusive whole-action plus child-stage timing
action measurement and attempt source hashes refer to authentic, uniquely joined original evidence
input contains every executed attempt including all failures and retries
canonical_accounting.shared_attempts: reject across actions; no prefix-sharing allocation or online incremental cost claim
canonical_accounting.measurement_sha256: shape-checked source declaration, not authenticated file content or D95 proof
canonical_accounting.failed_actions: ledger retains costs; fit seam rejects terminal FAILED/TIMEOUT without filtering
canonical_accounting.not_implemented: raw Phase2/3/4 adapter, retry_group/invocation lineage recovery, inclusive timing disambiguation and online prefix reuse

replay.scope: single TRAIN circuit, complete UID permutation, static additive historical proxy only
replay.stop: first epsilon-hit or min(K,N), charge visited action before checking hit
replay.hit: only explicit whole-action SUCCESS, D95=1, exact integer epsilon against safe SUCCESS reference
replay.no_reference: reject explicitly; never silently discard circuit or invent oracle
replay.censoring: retain hit=false and all visited charges; not a hit-only speedup or online runtime estimate

next: real-reader adapter/provenance and physical freeze design plus numerical-domain/trainer support; no automatic real data or training release
